hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ -f Cargo.toml ] || exit 0; s=$(date +%s.%N); if cargo build -q 2>/tmp/claude-build.log; then st='ok'; else n=$(grep -c '^error' /tmp/claude-build.log 2>/dev/null); st="FAILED, ${n:-?} error(s) (see /tmp/claude-build.log)"; fi; t=$(awk "BEGIN{printf \"%.1f\", $(date +%s.%N)-$s}"); printf '{"systemMessage":"build: %s in %ss"}\n' "$st" "$t"
